name: codex-desktop-pet
description: Run a Codex-bound desktop companion with automatic lifecycle, native plugin-page controls, selection shortcuts, OCR, persistent chat, screen comments, and detailed activity states.

interface.longDescription: Configure a Codex-bound native Windows companion directly from the plugin details page. It starts and exits with Codex, asks about selected text, performs OCR, keeps per-pet Codex chats, separates screen comments from answers, and maps privacy-preserving lifecycle events to animations.
defaultPrompt: Set up Codex Desktop Pet on this Windows computer
Diagnose why the desktop pet cannot read my selected text
Enable selected-text questions in official Pets Quick Chat
